comments: Scope note: the checker is a static scan of linked stylesheets and inline <style> only; runtime JavaScript/GSAP motion is not covered, and it reports candidates rather than a conformance verdict. The core engine is MIT-licensed (npm: motionspec); the same checks run in the web tool, the CLI and the MCP server. Contact: Kevin Fröba.
features: MotionSpec checks web animation for accessibility. Paste a URL: a static scan of linked CSS and <style> blocks flags motion outside a prefers-reduced-motion guard and infinite animation without a pause path (WCAG 2.2.2, 2.3.3), listing affected selectors and suggested fixes. Also available as MIT-licensed CLI (npx motionspec) and MCP server.
title: MotionSpec
